aiGuidance.extraction: Exactly one `selects` relation to a care-mode.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Agents never edit policy records: propose a change as a comment on the record, with the evidence.
aiGuidance.purpose: The tuning surface: reorder, tighten or loosen rules to change how careful work is.

description: One ordered rule: when its clauses hold for a work item, it selects a care mode. Rules are tried in policy_order and the first match wins; the last rule has no clauses and catches everything.
name: care-rule
